**STEP 7 - Energy:** Boiled sweet corn is about 90 kcal/100 g. 65 g × 0.90 ≈ 58 kcal. The cob itself is inedible and contributes little energy, so this is an upper-leaning estimate.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** One short cob segment on a large plate should weigh well under 100 g, and about 60 kcal fits that.
